data_collection_breadth.evidence: Collects: username, password, email/phone, birthday, messages, posts, voice messages, custom emojis, files, payment info, friend lists, server participation, roles, IP, OS, browser type, device settings. Generally doesn't store voice/video call contents (advance notice if changed). From third parties: other users, social media, advertisers, data providers.

third_party_sharing.evidence: "Discord prioritizes privacy and doesn't sell personal information." Business model is subscription-based, not ad-driven. Shares with: vendors (payment processors, cloud providers, analytics), related companies, legal compliance, business transitions. Aggregated/de-identified info shared. Less ad-partner sharing than ad-driven platforms.

tracking_advertising.evidence: Revenue from 'subscriptions, paid products, and sponsored content' -- not primarily ad-based. 'Sponsored content: Surfacing Quests and sponsored formats. Users can limit this.' Users can 'Limit data collection for service improvement' and 'Control personalization and sponsored content delivery.' Less aggressive than ad-driven platforms.

data_retention_deletion.evidence: "Personal information is retained until no longer needed for processing purposes or legal compliance. Specific retention periods are detailed in Discord's data retention policy." Offers both disable and full delete. Data export within 30 days in JSON format. Defers to separate retention policy for specifics.

readability_honesty.evidence: Privacy Policy is well-structured with key principles up front: 'Discord prioritizes privacy and doesn't sell personal information.' Honest about data use: 'generally doesn't store video/voice call contents, though this could change with advance notice.' Business model clearly stated: 'revenue comes from subscriptions and sponsored content.' Relatively transparent.

encryption_security.evidence: "All information is encrypted in transit and at rest using TLS." "Voice and video communications are end-to-end encrypted (verification available in-service)." "Technical and administrative access controls limit employee/contractor access." "Two-factor authentication is available." E2E encryption for voice/video, encryption at rest, TLS in transit, 2FA -- the strongest security commitments of any platform analyzed.

creator_monetization.gap_note: Discord is not a creator monetization platform. While it has Nitro subscriptions and server subscriptions, these are platform features, not a creator revenue-sharing model comparable to YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Patreon, or Substack.
creator_monetization.evidence: Discord's business model is subscription-based (Nitro) and sponsored content (Quests). No creator revenue-sharing or payout system described in the ToS or Privacy Policy.
